title: Weighted integrals of 1-forms along unit-speed lines define a 1-current (parent step 1)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and ι a finite type. For each k ∈ ι let p_k, v_k ∈ ℝ^P with ‖v_k‖ = 1, let I_k ⊆ ℝ be an arbitrary set, and let c_k ∈ ℝ. Then there is a current X ∈ 𝒟_1(ℝ^P), that is, a GeometricCurrentOn univ 1: a linear functional on test 1-forms that is sequentially continuous at 0 for TestFormOnConverges. It satisfies X(ω) = Σ_k c_k·∫_{I_k} ω(p_k + t·v_k)(v_k) dt for every ω ∈ 𝒟¹(ℝ^P). Here ω(y)(v) means ω(y)(fun _ => v), and ∫_{I_k} is the Bochner integral for Lebesgue measure restricted to I_k.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (p v : ι → Euclid P) (I : ι → Set ℝ) (c : ι → ℝ), (∀ k, ‖v k‖ = 1) → ∃ X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1, ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1, X ω = ∑ k, c k * ∫ t in I k, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 1) (p k + t • v k) (fun _ => v k)
